measured.design: Run the CORRECTED CLIENT_DESTINATION_MAPPING_CHECK (three simultaneous identities against the independent hard-coded parser-sequence oracle) against: (0) an unmutated private copy of the canonical document (MUST PASS — negative control proving a correct field-index/name/VA/destination tuple passes); (A) destination-cell-only swap (MUST FAIL); (B) destination+displacement swap with the OLD VAs (MUST FAIL); (C) destination+displacement+MATCHING REAL STORE VA swap — each row at the OTHER field's real store (MUST FAIL; the class the BASE verifier passed undetected). Raw VFS values stay unchanged in every case; the full QC is re-run per case and must FAIL whenever TQ2 fails.

canonical_copy_negative_control.description: unmutated private copy of the canonical document (nothing replaced)

mutantA_destination_cell_only.description: destination cells swapped only (Desktop replica): payload[1] dest +0x04 / payload[2] dest +0x08, instruction cells unchanged
per_row_reasons: payload[1] (A): DESTINATION FIELD IDENTITY FAIL: documented destination template+0x04 != oracle destination template+0x08 for payload[1] (A)
payload[2] (B): DESTINATION FIELD IDENTITY FAIL: documented destination template+0x08 != oracle destination template+0x04 for payload[2] (B)

mutantB_destination_disp_old_va.description: destination+displacement swap with the OLD store VAs kept (@0x00730CE6 / @0x00730D14)
per_row_reasons: payload[1] (A): DESTINATION FIELD IDENTITY FAIL: documented destination template+0x04 != oracle destination template+0x08 for payload[1] (A)
payload[1] (A): documented instruction displacement 0x04 != oracle destination 0x08 of payload[1] (A)'s assigned store instruction
payload[2] (B): DESTINATION FIELD IDENTITY FAIL: documented destination template+0x08 != oracle destination template+0x04 for payload[2] (B)
payload[2] (B): documented instruction displacement 0x08 != oracle destination 0x04 of payload[2] (B)'s assigned store instruction

mutantC_destination_disp_real_store_va_s.description: destination+displacement+MATCHING REAL STORE VA swap: payload[1](A)->template+0x04->MOV [EDI+0x04],EAX @0x00730D14; payload[2](B)->template+0x08->MOV [EDI+0x08],EAX @0x00730CE6 (each row at the OTHER payload field's REAL store)
per_row_reasons: payload[1] (A): STORE INSTRUCTION IDENTITY FAIL: documented store VA 0x00730D14 is the store of payload[2] (B) per the independent parser-sequence oracle, NOT the store of payload[1] (A) (oracle assigns payload[1] (A) store VA 0x00730CE6, bytes 89 47 08)
payload[1] (A): DESTINATION FIELD IDENTITY FAIL: documented destination template+0x04 != oracle destination template+0x08 for payload[1] (A)
payload[1] (A): documented instruction displacement 0x04 != oracle destination 0x08 of payload[1] (A)'s assigned store instruction

payload[2] (B): STORE INSTRUCTION IDENTITY FAIL: documented store VA 0x00730CE6 is the store of payload[1] (A) per the independent parser-sequence oracle, NOT the store of payload[2] (B) (oracle assigns payload[2] (B) store VA 0x00730D14, bytes 89 47 04)
payload[2] (B): DESTINATION FIELD IDENTITY FAIL: documented destination template+0x08 != oracle destination template+0x04 for payload[2] (B)
payload[2] (B): documented instruction displacement 0x08 != oracle destination 0x04 of payload[2] (B)'s assigned store instruction
